subject: Round-2 re-review: FAIL (9 MAJOR, 7 MINOR new)
body: I re-reviewed the revised spec against round 1, re-read all 22 citations the revision added or changed, and ran /sc:spec-panel-ledger in its Verify step (status and verify --dry-run only; dry-run ok, U=7, loop_decision CONTINUE, new rows R18-R33). All 13 blocking round-1 rows are resolved in the spec text and 20 of 22 citations hold (1 overstated, 1 wrong test record), but 7 fixes introduced new defects: WC-4a has no report path for research/task/recommend, the TFEP fix puts an unscheduled duty on /sc:task, WC-3 contradicts AC-2.2, the P1 blocked-report rule lacks paths, WC-10 contradicts itself at 240 s and cannot detect a hung subagent, and the step-6 rewrite makes P0's AC-0.4 unpassable. Verdict FAIL with 16 new findings (9 MAJOR, 7 MINOR); left for the coordinator: run the ledger's verify and close steps with this report, then a review-3 fix cycle.
